description_en: Modifies the collection types of audit logs for an ApsaraDB for MongoDB instance
description_zh: 修改MongoDB实例审计日志的采集类型
kebab_example: aliyun dds modify-audit-log-filter --db-instance-id dds-bp12c5b040dc0000 --filter insert,query,update,delete --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyAuditLogFilter

parameters.help_en:
The collection types of audit logs. Separate multiple collection types with commas (,).
admin: O&M and management operations.
slow: Slow queries.
query: Query operations.
insert: Insert operations.  
update: Update operations.  
delete: Delete operations. 
command: Protocol commands, such as the aggregate method
parameters.help_zh:
设置审计日志的采集类型，多个采集类型请用英文逗号分隔。
admin：运维管控操作。
slow：慢日志。
query：查询操作。
insert：插入操作。  
update：更新操作。  
delete：删除操作。 
command：协议命令。例如aggregate聚合方法。
parameters.name: filter

parameters.help_en:
The role of the node in the instance. Valid values:
db: shard node
mongos: mongos node






Metric description
This parameter applies only to sharded cluster instances. If this parameter is left empty, the default value db is used. You do not need to specify this parameter for replica set instances
parameters.help_zh:
实例中节点的角色，取值：
db：shard节点
mongos：mongos节点






参数说明
当前参数只适合分片集群，为空时默认为db，副本集无需传入
parameters.name: role_type
